blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–University of the Philippines will compete in the upcoming Asian University Basketball League (AUBL) under a new home-and-away format for the group stage. The Fighting Maroons will represent the Philippines against schools from Japan, South Korea, China and Mongolia. UP, which leads the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament with a 7-2 record, is in Group 4 with Japan’s Nippon Sport Science University and Nihon University. Group 1 will have Yonsei University, Tsinghua University and Shanghai Jiao Tong University.
